question: In which year the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) were adopted by the United Nations?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2015**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) were adopted by all United Nations Member States during the **UN Sustainable Development Summit** held in New York.
 
• The adoption of the SDGs took place on **25 September 2015**.
 
• The SDGs consist of **17 goals** aimed at addressing global challenges such as poverty, inequality, climate change, environmental degradation, peace, and justice.
 
• The SDGs are part of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, which provides a shared blueprint for peace and prosperity for people and the planet, now and into the future.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Millennium Development Goals (MDGs):**

 
 
• The SDGs succeeded the Millennium Development Goals, which were eight goals set to be achieved by 2015.
 
• The MDGs focused on a narrower set of issues such as eradicating extreme poverty and hunger, achieving universal primary education, and reducing child mortality.
 
 
 
• **2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development:**
 
 
• This agenda was adopted by all UN Member States in 2015.
 
• It includes 17 SDGs and 169 targets intended to be achieved by the year 2030.
 
• The agenda emphasizes a holistic approach to sustainable development for both developed and developing countries.
 
 
 
• **Partnerships for the Goals (SDG 17):**
 
 
• This goal emphasizes the need for global partnerships to achieve the ambitious targets of the SDGs.
 
• It focuses on strengthening the means of implementation and revitalizing the global partnership for sustainable development.
 
 
 
• **Leave No One Behind:**
 
 
• A core principle of the SDGs is to ensure that no one is left behind in the journey towards sustainable development.
 
• This includes addressing the needs of the most vulnerable and ensuring inclusivity and equity.
